const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a replayable shake_bottle trajectory for the frozen instance."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_traj import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("shake_bottle", instance=INSTANCE)
+    env = s.env
+    bottle_start = np.asarray(env.bottle.get_pose().p, dtype=float)
+    arm = "left" if bottle_start[0] < 0 else "right"
+
+    s.record_start()
+    grasp_actions = env.grasp_actor(
+        env.bottle,
+        arm,
+        pre_grasp_dis=0.10,
+        grasp_dis=0.0,
+    )
+    env.move(grasp_actions)
+    if env.plan_success:
+        # Raise the bottle clear of the table and leave a comfortable margin over
+        # the task's 0.8 m success threshold.
+        env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.15, move_axis="world"))
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    bottle_end = np.asarray(env.bottle.get_pose().p, dtype=float)
+    status = s.status()
+    print({
+        "arm": arm,
+        "bottle_start": bottle_start.tolist(),
+        "bottle_end": bottle_end.tolist(),
+        "plan_success": bool(env.plan_success),
+        "recorded_steps": int(len(actions)),
+        **status,
+    })
+    if not status["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("Recorded attempt did not satisfy shake_bottle success predicate")
+
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"arm": arm, "method": "grasp_and_lift"})
+    replay = s.replay(actions)
+    print({"replay": replay, "trajectory": OUT})
+    if not replay["success"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("Open-loop replay did not satisfy shake_bottle success predicate")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
